note: Cups for the AIS haptic-search robot demo (ais_haptic/robot_frame.py). tcp_offset: UR set_tcp [m, rad], cup lip on the cup axis. chamber_map[i] = sensor channel of simulator chamber i; body_offset_deg = simulator body yaw minus tool yaw (seen from above). Both are measured with ais_chamber_check.py; until then calibrated=false and only --dry-run works. Old ROS1 hints (not trusted): 3ch pressure order [1, 2, 0]; yaw = -tool_yaw - 90 deg. lip_radius_mm: sealing-lip radius (simulator 5 mm); measure on the real cup.

ch3.chamber_check_note: 2026-11-25 scan re-analysed with channel differences (the cup leaked as a whole: lip 2 mm over the chamfered bore). Channel 0 direction agrees with the visual check (about 60 deg clockwise from base +x at tool yaw -87). Fit rms 1.2 deg.
